answer: Octopuses are incredibly intelligent creatures with problem-solving skills that rivals some mammals. They have a highly developed nervous system and have been observed using tools, solving puzzles, and even playing games. One fascinating fact is that they can escape from enclosures and exhibit a variety of escape styles, often using their camouflage ability to blend in during the escape.
